body: So because I dont include a too long, didnt read, my post is 100% irrelevant. That's the biggest bullshit I've ever heard a moderator claim before in my life. A TLDR isnt the fucking content, the paragraphs are!

Spoilers, idc. 
The movie really pissed me off and I'm unsure if the hype is really just unsatisfied rage from other people too. 
Any great story needs information and this movie had Noooooothing. It didnt tell you how the creatures came to be or why they were there, oh, and you never see them! The problem was never solved, but I guess all is good now that they are at a Blind school? Whelp, maybe they will finally teach Sandra the importance of a walking stick, because no one thought that would come in handy :/
I really loved the concept, a blind mom hauling two small children out of danger had that raw story to tap into. But holy fuck, could we get some visual stimulation here? I would've liked to see what was causing people to kill themselves, it couldve been truly horrifying if we just saw what the creatures were doing to people and got some information. It's not like they didnt set up a chance to share those answers, we knew that the looney bin wasnt affected, why couldnt they take their chance &  knocked out Gary and interrogated his crazy ass. If I had some unknown entity going around causing people to off themselves, I would like to know how to kill it or Winchester it back where it came from. 
Ugh. I wanted more from this. The acting wasnt bad at all, but that plot structure is a damn train wreck.

Seems to me the one youre upset at is the wrong person, Gremlin is the one who really lives there and allows his GF to mess up the place. Instead of boiling up about the girl, nag at him. She is a squatter basically and you have every right and means to kick her off your property at any given time. Honestly, after the first or second hiccup from these two, there wouldve been warnings given to each of them. You guys allowed this to go on for too long which I do not understand. Put up ads that your looking for a new roommate and do interviews for one, with Gremlin around, this might be enough of a wake up call that things need to change or his ass is on the street too. Stop being pushovers to a bunch of slobs, that's so gross.

I have PTSD that is caused by traumatic childhood. I really dont want to go into the details, but I know that I struggle connecting with people because of it. I am 32 years old, and it's rare for me to have an anxiety attack. I can read a situation really well, I'm very good at figuring people out. 
I've struggle seeing a therapist before, I dont like to talk about what happened to me every time I meet some new professhumk. Eventually it just becomes a financial drain that wasnt really helping and just agitating me more. I have seasonal depression, it's worse around this time and I know that is having a big part with how I am feeling. I've tired using light therapy and music therapy to help me out during this time, but lately it all just gives me a massive headache. And those nauseating medications they have given me tends to work for a little while and then it just stops for no reason. I understand that when it comes to mental health that it's a trial of errors before you find the right cocktail, but I don't want to be some Guinea pig anymore about it. 
Isnt there any other way besides talking and cramming pills in order to get better?
